comparison_resolution_check.name: comparison_resolution_check
comparison_resolution_check.value:
("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_at" is null) = ("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_by" is null)
          and ("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_at" is null) = (coalesce(btrim("evidence"."comparison"."resolution_note"), '') = '')
          and ("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_at" is null) = (coalesce(btrim("evidence"."comparison"."resolution_limit"), '') = '')
          and ("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_at" is null or "evidence"."comparison"."outcome" = 'contradiction')
          and ("evidence"."comparison"."resolved_at" is not null or "evidence"."comparison"."resolution_standing_source_id" is null)

duplicate_flag_resolved_check.name: duplicate_flag_resolved_check
duplicate_flag_resolved_check.value: ("evidence"."duplicate_flag"."resolution" is null) = ("evidence"."duplicate_flag"."resolved_by" is null) and ("evidence"."duplicate_flag"."resolution" is null) = ("evidence"."duplicate_flag"."resolved_at" is null)

evidence_gap_coverage_check.name: evidence_gap_coverage_check
evidence_gap_coverage_check.value:
("evidence"."evidence_gap"."kind" = 'no_evidence') = ("evidence"."evidence_gap"."files_inspected" is null)
          and ("evidence"."evidence_gap"."files_inspected" is null) = ("evidence"."evidence_gap"."coverage_reason" is null) and "evidence"."evidence_gap"."files_inspected" >= 0

repository_read_counts_check.name: repository_read_counts_check
repository_read_counts_check.value:
"evidence"."repository_read"."status" <> 'read' or ("evidence"."repository_read"."authored_commits" between 0 and "evidence"."repository_read"."total_commits"
          and "evidence"."repository_read"."generated_checked" between 0 and "evidence"."repository_read"."authored_commits"
          and "evidence"."repository_read"."generated_only_commits" between 0 and "evidence"."repository_read"."generated_checked")
